description: This PHP source file defines the SearchWrapper class, which provides a unified interface for performing searches using different search engines within the SuiteCRM system. It manages search engine configurations, dynamically loads engine classes, and offers methods for executing searches, retrieving engine info, and user preferences related to search modules.

classes.name: SearchWrapper
classes.description: A class that provides methods to perform searches, manage search engines, and retrieve search-related configurations within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: searchAndDisplay
methods.description: Performs a search with the given query and displays the results.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search with the specified engine and query, returning search results.

methods.name: addEngine
methods.description: Adds a new search engine configuration to the available engines list.

methods.name: getEngines
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available search engine class names, including custom engines.

methods.name: getDefaultEngine
methods.description: Retrieves the default search engine name from the global configuration.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Returns the configured search controller from the global configuration.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Returns the list of modules enabled for search.

methods.name: getModulesForDisplay
methods.description: Returns the list of enabled modules with their display labels.

methods.name: getUserSelectedModules
methods.description: Retrieves the modules selected by the current user for search, updating user preferences.

methods.name: fetchEngine
methods.description: Validates and retrieves an instance of a specified search engine class.

methods.name: getSearchConfig
methods.description: Fetches a specific search configuration parameter from the global $sugar_config array.
